packageRules.description: Qwik packages are released together with the same version; update them in one PR so they never mismatch.
The CI image must ship the browser build @playwright/test expects, and VRT baselines are tied to it; bump both in one PR.
TypeScript 7 waits for typescript-eslint (it has no JS API yet), so 6.x updates must keep coming in their own PRs; with a later major out too, each major gets its own PR rather than only the newest.
